students.desc: Exam results and body measurements of 600 students (gender is coded M=0, F=1 in the numeric array). About 3% of the numeric cells are blank -> nan.

columns.gender: text M/F in the csv; 0/1 in `students`

sensor.desc: 10,000 one-minute readings from an environment sensor (about 7 days). Contains blanks (nan), -999 error codes in humidity, temperature spikes, vibration bursts and a 40-minute outage.

houses.desc: 400 house sales for the regression project: price (in thousands) depends on area, bedrooms and age plus noise.
